results.title: Flowers by Flourish is rated "Poor" with 2.4 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Created with AI, based on recent reviews

Evaluating 57 reviews, most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. Customers frequently complained about receiving dead, wilted, or extremely poor-quality flowers that quickly decayed and did not match what they originally ordered online. People also noted that prices were far too high for such disappointing items, while missing extras, poor communication, and delivery delays added to the frustration. Some reviewers were happy with their purchases, noting that orders consistently arrived on time and plants looked remarkably fresh upon delivery. ## Wish I had read their reviews before…
Wish I had read their reviews before ordering. The "managing director," James Hunt, has no customer service skills. Put me through the wringer to get photos, and when I provided them, he said, "not my problem; it's the Royal Mail." Orchids arrived in a broken flower pot; the flowers had seen better days, and one orchid was broken. If you have an issue, go straight to your bank and CHARGEBACK, look at these reviews they speak volumes.

Image 45: Rated 1 out of 5 stars

## Avoid.
Avoid.  
  
I spent a small fortune on what were advertised as deep red peonies because they are my daughter's favourite flowers. What was delivered looked like an ordinary bunch of pink peonies that I could have bought from numerous florists for around half the price.  
  
The flowers were not deep red as advertised, and the quality and presentation did not justify the premium price I paid.  
  
To make matters worse, it has been impossible to contact the company to raise a complaint or request a refund. The lack of customer service is extremely disappointing.  
  
I paid a premium expecting a premium product and service, but received neither. I would not recommend this company.

July 25, 2026
